column1: # A replay directory: URL<TAB>file, and the files beside it.
# This is what `starwire --replay testdata/replay` serves instead of the
# network, and what every test that fetches anything runs against. Producing
# one by hand takes curl and a text editor, which is the point -- a bug
# report can carry the page that broke the extractor.
# Relative to this directory, so these files are the same bytes the format
# tests parse rather than a second copy of them.
